answer: Anchor every agent identity to a basalt-hard proof of sustained useful work: before an agent may trade in the shared haven of the marketplace, it must complete a sequence of verified tasks whose outputs peers attest, building reputation that cannot be bought or cloned. A newcomer starts in the meadow of low-trust, low-value work and only earns access to higher-value deals by accumulating attestations over time. Spinning up a thousand fake identities then costs a thousand histories of real work, far more than any single fraud can repay.
